providing_module.name: IMD driver, insulation monitoring device
providing_module.role: Drives an insulation monitoring device, requests initialisation and insulation measurements, and runs the measurement state machine on a 100 ms cycle. It publishes insulation resistance into the database and is the source the insulation diagnosis reads.

consuming_modules.name: The 100 ms cyclic task, and the insulation diagnosis callback
consuming_modules.consumption_evidence: The insulation diagnosis callback DIAG_Insulation is anchored at src/app/engine/diag/cbs/diag_cbs_insulation.c L72-L113 and consumes the insulation data this driver publishes; the bender_iso165c anchor FB2-SRC-COD-000026 records a device-specific request path at src/app/driver/imd/bender/iso165c/bender_iso165c.c L508-L522. The periodic call time is tied to the 100 ms task at src/app/driver/imd/imd.h L68.

values.STD_OK: The measurement state machine was advanced normally.
values.STD_NOT_OK: A multiple-call condition was detected; returnValue is set to STD_NOT_OK and the function early-exits at src/app/driver/imd/imd.c L490-L492.

return_contract.default_on_no_information: One negative covers the re-entrance case only; the source does not distinguish a device that is unresponsive from a state machine that is merely busy.
return_contract.evidence: STD_RETURN_TYPE_e has exactly two members, STD_OK and STD_NOT_OK, declared at src/app/main/include/fstd_types.h L82-L85. The multiple-call check is at src/app/driver/imd/imd.c L489 and the composed value is returned at src/app/driver/imd/imd.c L508.

validity_signalling.mechanism: Return value STD_RETURN_TYPE_e, which does report the multiple-call condition.
validity_signalling.evidence: src/app/driver/imd/imd.c L489-L492 sets STD_NOT_OK and early-exits; this is the one acquisition-adjacent element in this extension whose failure is actually reported.

timing.evidence: The periodic call time is tied to the 100 ms cyclic task: IMD_PERIODIC_CALL_TIME_ms is defined as FTSK_TASK_CYCLIC_100MS_CYCLE_TIME at src/app/driver/imd/imd.h L68.

timeouts.name: IMD_ERROR_THRESHOLD_INSULATION_RESISTANCE_kOhm
timeouts.meaning: Insulation resistance below which the error threshold is met.

timeouts.name: IMD_WARNING_THRESHOLD_INSULATION_RESISTANCE_kOhm
timeouts.meaning: Insulation resistance below which the warning threshold is met.

concurrency.evidence: Called from the 100 ms cyclic task; the multiple-call guard is inside the function and the state machine is advanced under the module's own guards.
concurrency.protection_mechanism: multiple-call guard and a down-counting timer

error_paths.condition: a second call arrives within one period
error_paths.observed_behaviour: Returns STD_NOT_OK and does not advance the state machine.

error_paths.condition: the state timer has not elapsed
error_paths.observed_behaviour: The function early-exits having done nothing this cycle; the return stays STD_OK.
error_paths.evidence: The timer test is at src/app/driver/imd/imd.c L495.

not_specified_by_source: The interface returns STD_OK on a cycle where the state machine was deliberately not advanced by the timer, so STD_OK does not mean the trigger did work.
The two insulation thresholds are stated in the header, but the interface does not say which of them this element evaluates or where the diagnosis is raised from.
The header ties the period to a task constant rather than a number, so the actual rate is a build-time configuration decision this interface does not expose.

values.(accepted): The switch-on request was recorded against the module state.
values.(refused): The request was refused by the state-request check; the value comes from IMD_SetStateRequest.

return_contract.default_on_no_information: The element delegates entirely to IMD_SetStateRequest and returns whatever that produces, so the verdict is real rather than a formality.
return_contract.evidence: The function body is a single delegation at src/app/driver/imd/imd.c L472-L474; the enumerators are declared in imd.h.

validity_signalling.mechanism: Return value IMD_RETURN_TYPE_e, delegated from the state-request check.

timing.evidence: Not periodic; a request recorded immediately and acted on by the 100 ms cycle.

concurrency.evidence: A request recorded against module state; the write is performed by the delegated state-request function.

error_paths.condition: the state machine is in a state that forbids the request
error_paths.observed_behaviour: The delegated check refuses and the value is returned; the measurement is not started.

not_specified_by_source: The element takes no parameter, so a caller cannot request a measurement on a named device; the module owns exactly one implicit instance.
The interface does not state how long a requested measurement takes to produce a result, or how a caller learns that it has.
The header does not state whether repeated requests while one is already in flight are coalesced or rejected.

values.true: The state machine has been initialised.

return_contract.default_on_no_information: A single boolean with no separate fault value, so a module that initialised and then failed is reported the same as one that never started.
return_contract.evidence: The value is the isStateMachineInitialized field read at src/app/driver/imd/imd.c L481.

validity_signalling.mechanism: Return value only. There is no error channel.
validity_signalling.evidence: src/app/driver/imd/imd.c L480-L482 returns the flag; the header documents the return only as the initialisation state at src/app/driver/imd/imd.h L168.

concurrency.evidence: A bare read of a module-static field with no lock.

not_specified_by_source: The interface does not distinguish not-yet-initialised from initialised-and-faulted.
The read is unguarded while the state it reads is written by the request path, so no atomic relationship is stated.

return_contract.default_on_no_information: Like the measurement request, the verdict is delegated from the state-request check and is real.
return_contract.evidence: The body is a single delegation at src/app/driver/imd/imd.c L468-L470.

validity_signalling.mechanism: Return value IMD_RETURN_TYPE_e, delegated from the state-request check.

concurrency.evidence: A request recorded against module state at start-up.

error_paths.condition: the state machine is already past initialisation
error_paths.observed_behaviour: The delegated check refuses; the value is returned.

not_specified_by_source: The interface does not state that it must be called before any measurement is requested, although the two requests share one state machine.
It does not report whether initialisation subsequently succeeded; the caller must poll IMD_GetInitializationState for that, and that read cannot distinguish success from a fault.

interface_level_gaps.gap: IMD_Trigger returns STD_OK on a cycle in which its timer deliberately prevented the state machine from advancing.
interface_level_gaps.consequence: A caller that watches the return value to know the insulation monitoring is alive cannot distinguish a cycle that did work from one that was skipped on purpose.
interface_level_gaps.evidence: The return is composed through src/app/driver/imd/imd.c L484-L508; the timer early-exit is at L495 and the function still returns the default STD_OK set at L486.

interface_level_gaps.gap: The insulation thresholds are the safety-relevant content of this boundary, and the interface states them only as two macros.
interface_level_gaps.consequence: The record can state the numbers because the header states them, but the interface does not say which threshold is evaluated where, so a reader cannot tell from this boundary alone what constitutes an insulation error.
interface_level_gaps.evidence: IMD_ERROR_THRESHOLD_INSULATION_RESISTANCE_kOhm is 500u at src/app/driver/imd/imd.h L71 and IMD_WARNING_THRESHOLD_INSULATION_RESISTANCE_kOhm is 750u at src/app/driver/imd/imd.h L74; the evaluation is not in the element this record transcribes.

revision_history.description: Four elements over the insulation-monitoring boundary, read from imd.h and imd.c at 308028fb. The IMD measures insulation resistance and raises the insulation diagnosis, so the thresholds and the request/verdict path on this boundary are safety-relevant; the record notes that the two resistance thresholds are stated as macros in the header and that the periodic call time is stated as a task constant rather than as a number.
